# The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Constructive Data Modeling

> An exact, time-indexed Foldkit companion to Alexis King's Software Should Work 2026 talk.

The companion has 40 authored visual states plus the recording's question-and-answer tail. Every state has recording start and end times, a YouTube deep link, and the corresponding condensed-page and 158-page reveal locators. The deliberate return from generic `Ior` to the domain-named `UserContact` slide is preserved.

The embedded YouTube recording and cue deck synchronize in both directions: choosing a cue seeks the recording, and playback crossing a cue boundary selects the corresponding cue. Stable cues can also be selected with `?slide=<slide-id>`. Keyboard controls are Left, Right, Space, Home, and End. Browser, command-line, and terminal hosts consume the same renderer-neutral Model and Message union.
